title: Rate, Efficiency, Power, and Cycling Boundaries in a Flow-Electrochemical System
scientific_scope: All frozen charge-like and discharge-like curves, rate-dependent efficiency and power summaries, and the complete long-cycle capacity sequence in the task boundary.

license_boundary: The archived target article and source-data workbook are CC BY; the task bundles every numerical point in the frozen rate, summary, and cycling series.
warnings: Anonymous rate labels preserve ordering but not source-device identity; interpretations must stay within the supplied system.

source_coverage_statement: The bundled files are complete within the scientific_scope declared for this task. This does not assert that every variable, record, or file in the upstream scientific source is included.
